abstract: This study examines exit from active professional boat racing as a form of exit from performance-based self-employment. Boat racers operate in an individual prize-based labour market in which income opportunities, reputation, and career continuity depend on current performance and periodic institutional evaluation. Drawing on lifecycle models of self-employment and retirement, this study estimates pooled probit models using racer-period panel data from Japan’s professional boat racing industry. Next-period exit is modelled as a function of current performance, accumulated career success, individual characteristics, racing class, and period effects. Current performance is measured by the first-place finish rate in individual races, while accumulated career success is measured by cumulative victories in multi-day race series. The results show that current performance is negatively associated with exit probability, but this exit-deterring association becomes smaller and statistically insignificant among racers with greater accumulated career success. The findings suggest that exit from performance-contingent work depends not only on weaker current performance, but also on how current returns are evaluated relative to accumulated career capital. KEYWORDS: Self-employment exit athlete retirement performance-based self-employment professional labour markets occupational exit JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J26 J44 L83 Acknowledgements The author is grateful to the editor and the anonymous referees for their constructive comments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了退出职业赛艇竞技作为一种退出基于绩效的自雇就业形式的现象。赛艇选手在个人奖金制的劳动力市场中运作，其收入机会、声誉及职业连续性取决于当前表现及定期的机构评估。借鉴自雇与退休的生命周期模型，本研究利用日本职业赛艇行业的选手-时期面板数据，估计了合并概率模型。下一期的退出行为被建模为当前表现、累积职业成就、个人特征、赛艇级别及时期效应的函数。当前表现以个人赛事中的第一名完成率衡量，而累积职业成就则以多日系列赛事中的累计胜利次数衡量。结果显示，当前表现与退出概率呈负相关，但这种退出抑制效应在累积职业成就较高的选手中减弱且统计上不显著。研究结果表明，从绩效依赖型工作中退出不仅取决于当前表现的减弱，还取决于当前回报相对于累积职业资本的评估方式。关键词：自雇退出 运动员退休 基于绩效的自雇 专业劳动力市场 职业退出 JEL分类：J24 J26 J44 L83 致谢 作者感谢编辑及匿名审稿人的建设性意见。
title: Exit from performance-based self-employment: evidence from professional boat racers
title_zh: 退出绩效型自雇：来自职业赛艇选手的证据

abstract: We estimate the impact of inward immigration on city-level inflation in the United States. We find that doubling the rate of immigration reduces inflation by about 0.1 to 0.2 percentage points. The disinflationary effect is concentrated in goods prices. Effects are larger for working-age immigrants, with suggestive but less precise evidence of stronger disinflationary effects from less-educated immigrants, especially in services. Housing markets respond differently: immigration increases local housing prices, with the largest effects for higher-education immigrants. Our results are jointly rationalized by a simple general equilibrium model where substitutability of capital and labor varies across industries but capital is fixed in the short run.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了美国境内移民流入对城市层面通货膨胀的影响。研究发现，移民率翻倍会使通货膨胀率下降约0.1至0.2个百分点。这一通缩效应主要集中在商品价格上。对于处于劳动年龄的移民，其影响更为显著；尽管证据尚不精确，但提示性结果表明，教育程度较低的移民，尤其是在服务业领域，可能带来更强的通缩效应。住房市场的反应则有所不同：移民推高了当地房价，其中对高学历移民的影响最为显著。我们的研究结果通过一个简单的通用均衡模型得到了统一解释，该模型假设资本与劳动的替代性在不同行业间存在差异，但短期内资本固定不变。
title: Immigration and local inflation: Evidence from US cities
title_zh: 移民与地方通胀：来自美国城市的证据

abstract: We estimate the temporal association between high-stakes exam timing and media-reported student suicides in India using geocoded news data. Student suicides are 17.5 percent higher during months in which NEET-UG or JEE-Mains examinations are held, with no comparable pattern around lower-stakes board exams or among adults. The association is concentrated when national entrance exams coincide with board exams, suggesting the salience of cumulative exam burden. These patterns are stronger among girls, in states with higher exam participation, and in urbanised districts. Event-study estimates show suicides increasing immediately before and during exams, while movements around result announcements are weaker and less precisely estimated. We find no evidence that broad shifts in media attention during cyclone or election months account for the pattern, although exam-specific reporting bias cannot be ruled out. In the absence of mental health data, we generate an alternative database to address a policy question and spur future research.
abstract_zh: 我们利用地理编码的新闻数据，估算了印度高风险考试时间与媒体报道的学生自杀事件之间的时间关联。在举行NEET-UG或JEE-Mains考试的月份，学生自杀率高出17.5%，而低风险委员会考试或成年人群体中则未出现类似模式。这一关联在全国性入学考试与委员会考试时间重叠时更为集中，表明累积考试负担的显著性。这些模式在女生群体、考试参与率较高的邦以及城市化程度较高的地区中更为明显。事件研究估计显示，自杀事件在考试前夕及考试期间立即增加，而成绩公布前后的变动则较弱且估计精度较低。我们没有发现气旋或选举月份媒体关注度的广泛转移能解释这一模式的证据，尽管无法排除针对考试特定报道偏差的可能性。在缺乏心理健康数据的情况下，我们构建了一个替代数据库，以回应政策问题并推动未来研究。
title: Under Pressure: High-Stakes Exams and Media-Reported Student Suicides in India1
title_zh: 压力之下：印度高风险考试与媒体报道的学生自杀事件

abstract: Access to safe and reliable drinking water remains uneven across sub-Saharan Africa, yet existing evidence largely focuses on health outcomes and binary measures of access, overlooking how different service levels affect everyday well-being. This study examines how the water service ladder shapes the emotional and physical burdens of water poverty and whether these effects differ by household head gender in Mozambique. Using nationally representative data from the 2022–2023 Mozambique Demographic and Health Survey and a multivalued treatment effects framework, we estimate the impacts of unimproved, limited, basic, and safely managed water services on water-related worry, anger, hygiene deprivation, and insufficient drinking water. Results show that limited services, i.e., improved sources located more than 30 min away, do not significantly reduce water-related distress relative to unimproved sources. In contrast, both basic and safely managed services substantially reduce emotional and physical burdens, with no additional gains from on-premises access beyond the 30-minute accessibility threshold. Female-headed households are more likely to access improved services, but the well-being benefits of improved water access do not differ by household head gender. These findings highlight the importance of service proximity rather than source type alone and suggest that progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 6 may be overstated when measured using binary indicators of improved access. The results emphasize the need for policy strategies that prioritize reducing collection time to deliver meaningful well-being gains from water infrastructure investments.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区安全可靠饮用水的获取仍不均衡，然而现有证据主要关注健康结果和二元化的获取指标，忽视了不同服务水平对日常福祉的影响。本研究考察了供水服务阶梯如何塑造水贫困的情感和身体负担，以及这些影响是否因莫桑比克户主性别而异。利用2022-2023年莫桑比克人口与健康调查的全国代表性数据以及多值处理效应框架，我们估算了未改善、有限、基本和安全管理的供水服务对与水相关的担忧、愤怒、卫生剥夺和饮用水不足的影响。结果显示，有限服务（即距离超过30分钟的改善水源）相对于未改善水源并未显著减少与水相关的困扰。相比之下，基本服务和安全管理的服务均大幅减少了情感和身体负担，而超过30分钟可达性阈值后，入户取水并未带来额外收益。女性户主家庭更可能获得改善服务，但改善供水获取的福祉收益并不因户主性别而异。这些发现强调了服务可达距离的重要性，而非仅关注水源类型本身，并表明当使用二元化的改善获取指标衡量时，可持续发展目标6的进展可能被高估。研究结果强调，政策策略需优先缩短取水时间，以从供水基础设施投资中实现有意义的福祉提升。
title: Emotional and physical burdens of water poverty: evidence from the drinking water service ladder in Mozambique
title_zh: 水贫困的情感与身体负担：来自莫桑比克饮用水服务阶梯的证据

abstract: Tax loss carryforwards (TLCF) — accumulated losses that reduce taxable income — are an important and risky corporate asset. We show theoretically how TLCF affect equity risk: If TLCF are low and used with certainty, equity risk decreases in TLCF because TLCF represent a safe cash flow; if TLCF are high, equity risk increases in TLCF because TLCF increase after-tax cash flows in good times but may expire unused or be deferred in bad times. In a calibrated model the latter effect dominates and risk increases in TLCF on average. Empirically, TLCF positively forecast firms’ volatility, beta, and return.
abstract_zh: 税收亏损结转（TLCF）——即减少应税收入的累计亏损——是一项重要且具有风险的企业资产。我们从理论上展示了TLCF如何影响股权风险：若TLCF较低且确定会被使用，则因其代表安全的现金流，股权风险随TLCF增加而降低；若TLCF较高，则因TLCF在景气时期增加税后现金流，但在不景气时期可能未使用而到期或递延，股权风险随TLCF增加而上升。在标定模型中，后一种效应占主导，平均而言风险随TLCF增加而上升。实证上，TLCF正向预测企业的波动率、贝塔系数及回报率。
title: Tax loss carryforwards and firms’ risk
title_zh: 税收亏损结转与企业风险

abstract: We investigate links between routine-biased technical change, the structure of occupational employment, and cross-country income differences. To implement this, we combine several data sources, including national labour force surveys and the Penn World Tables. In our novel dataset spanning 92 countries, we document a negative relationship between the employment share of routine occupations and GDP per hour worked. We then conduct a development accounting exercise in which we differentiate labour inputs by occupation and allow for occupation-specific technologies. We find a systematic relationship between occupation-specific productivities and development. Labour in routine occupations tends to be much more productive in richer countries, with effective productivity in the top 25 percent being about 14 times higher than in the bottom 25 percent of countries ranked by GDP per hour worked. Cross-country gaps in routine technology alone account for about 17 percent of the 90–10 ratio of GDP per hour worked, whereas differences in abstract labour technology do not contribute to the observed GDP dispersion. Eliminating all occupations’ and capital’s technology differences would compress the GDP distribution by 32 to 40 percent.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了常规偏向型技术变革、职业就业结构与跨国收入差异之间的联系。为实现这一目标，我们整合了包括国家劳动力调查和宾大世界表在内的多个数据源。在我们覆盖92个国家的新数据集中，我们记录了常规职业就业份额与每小时工作GDP之间的负相关关系。随后，我们进行了一项发展核算分析，按职业区分劳动投入，并允许职业特定技术的存在。我们发现，职业特定生产率与发展水平之间存在系统性关联。在较富裕国家，常规职业中的劳动力往往生产率更高，其中前25%国家的有效生产率约为按每小时工作GDP排名后25%国家的14倍。仅常规技术的跨国差距就解释了每小时工作GDP的90-10比率的约17%，而抽象劳动技术的差异并未对观察到的GDP离散度做出贡献。消除所有职业和资本的技术差异将使GDP分布压缩32%至40%。
title: Routine-biased technical change, structure of employment, and cross-country income differences
title_zh: 常规偏向型技术变革、就业结构与跨国收入差异

abstract: Crop insurance is an important instrument to protect farmers against extreme weather events. Many countries provide subsidies for crop insurance products to make insurance more affordable for farmers. The Federal Crop Insurance Program in the United States and major European crop insurance programs such as in Spain, Italy, and France focus on subsidized multi‐peril crop insurance contracts that cover losses from various natural hazards (e.g., hail, wind, drought, frost). We study how making premium subsidies more flexible and allowing farmers to buy subsidized single‐peril contracts affects insurance demand. We theoretically show that single‐peril subsidies are more effective than multi‐peril subsidies at increasing insurance demand against specific perils. Single‐peril subsidies may, however, crowd out insurance demand against other risks, when risks are correlated. Using a series of premium subsidies introduced by different German states aimed at increasing frost insurance demand of winegrowers, we compare the effects of subsidies for single‐peril (frost only) insurance contracts to the effects of subsidies for multi‐peril (hail and frost) insurance contracts. We empirically show that both subsidies lead to a similarly strong increase in frost insurance demand. We also find that single‐peril frost insurance subsidies do not crowd out hail insurance demand which is in line with our theory as frost and hail are independent risks. Our results demonstrate that allowing for more flexibility in contract choices can make subsidy programs more effective without reducing coverage against other, uncorrelated risks.
abstract_zh: 农作物保险是保护农民免受极端天气事件影响的重要工具。许多国家为农作物保险产品提供补贴，以使农民更能负担得起保险。美国的联邦农作物保险计划以及欧洲主要的农作物保险计划（如西班牙、意大利和法国）侧重于补贴型多重风险农作物保险合同，这些合同覆盖各种自然灾害（如冰雹、风灾、干旱、霜冻）造成的损失。我们研究了使保费补贴更加灵活并允许农民购买受补贴的单风险合同如何影响保险需求。我们从理论上证明，在增加针对特定风险的保险需求方面，单风险补贴比多重风险补贴更为有效。然而，当风险相关时，单风险补贴可能会挤出对其他风险的保险需求。利用德国各州推出的一系列旨在提高葡萄种植者霜冻保险需求的保费补贴，我们比较了单风险（仅霜冻）保险合同补贴与多重风险（冰雹和霜冻）保险合同补贴的效果。我们实证表明，两种补贴均导致霜冻保险需求出现类似的显著增长。我们还发现，单风险霜冻保险补贴并未挤出冰雹保险需求，这与我们的理论一致，因为霜冻和冰雹是独立风险。我们的结果表明，在合同选择上允许更大的灵活性可以使补贴计划更加有效，同时不会减少对其他不相关风险的保障。
title: Premium subsidy designs and crowding out of insurance demand
title_zh: 保费补贴设计与保险需求挤出效应

abstract: The role of non-bank financial intermediaries in the financial system has increased markedly over recent decades. This column documents how the growth of private markets, one of the fastest growing segments of the sector, has created multiple channels of interconnection between banks, firms, institutional investors, private equity, and private credit funds. Banks’ exposures extend from lending to common borrowers, to direct lending to funds, financing vehicles and linkages with asset managers. While available measures suggest that euro area banks’ exposures remain limited, data gaps and hidden leverage make it difficult for intermediaries and supervisors to assess risks across the full intermediation chain.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，非银行金融中介在金融体系中的作用显著增强。本文记录了私人市场——该领域增长最快的部分之一——的发展如何创造了银行、企业、机构投资者、私募股权及私人信贷基金之间的多重互联渠道。银行的敞口范围从向共同借款人的贷款，扩展到对基金的直接贷款、融资工具以及与资产管理人的联系。尽管现有指标显示欧元区银行的敞口仍然有限，但数据缺口和隐性杠杆使得中介机构和监管者难以评估整个中介链条中的风险。
authors: Maria Alessia Aiello, Raffaele Gallo, Ivan Quaglia
title: European banks and private markets: Mapping the linkages
title_zh: 欧洲银行与私人市场：关联性图谱
